No. 1982/14– TUESDAY, AUGUST, 30, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. :WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/13.

Land Ministry’s Ref No. : 4/3/10/2012/LRB/221. I hereby give notice, under sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No.28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the abandon paddy field described below and located between Pitawella Road” Boralesgamuwa and Borupona Bridge to create a water reserve under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project. Description of the land to be acquired: One hundred and eighteen (118) allotments of land called in total extent of about 33.9827 Hectares, situated in the villages called Werahera and Boralesgamuwa in the Grama Niladhari Divisions of No. 577 of Werahera North, No. 533 B of Boralesgamuwa West A, No. 533 of Boralesgamuwa West B, No. 577 A of Werahera South in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of Western Province and bounded as Follows:—
